column7: O
Dialog from loc
O
Quick! Hurry up and kill them!
Don't rush, Power Ring. We need to take our time to enjoy the hunt.
Who are you people? Why do you look exactly the same as us?
It's completely pointless even if you know the answer.
From now on, this world belongs to the Crime Syndicate.
Are you serious? That's all you've got?
You'll have to get past me if you want invade this land!
This ends here.
Perhaps now is the time for a peaceful conversation. Shall we start with introducing yourselves?
Don't think that you can lie to us. No matter how you resist, the Lasso of Truth will force the truth out of you.
Impressive manner, Amazon, but your lasso is useless against me.
Who are you people?
Enough, Amazonian. With your deaths imminent, so what if you guys know who we are?
What do you mean?
Superman—no, he looks like a Superman who kills!
Everyone, regroup! Immediately!
Is this the best you losers can do? I was hoping for some real competition.
Cough... He's much more difficult to deal with compared to Superman.
Flash?
Don't worry, I'm here to help!
Okay. Got my wind back. Let’s force some SPEED.
This ends now!
The time of the Justice League is over. The Crime Syndicate rules now and forever.
Submit! This world belongs to the Crime Syndicate!
It's looking grim... Batman, all your allies have been eliminated.
They'll find our hiding place before long. If you have a backup plan, now's the time.
Let's retreat and cover our tracks first. The Batplane will pick us up.
Looks like we'll have to find a secluded strip of tarmac first.
Facial recognition failed. Initiating voice ID.
I am Batman.
...Are you serious?
Voice identification failed. Intruder alert activated. Commensing attack protocol.
Now that the big guy is down... What's next on the agenda? Shall we get the Justice League back together?
The Crime Syndicate has control over all possible communication signals. We can't contact anyone right now.
<static>
See? Dead silence on the comms device.
Wait. You mean the League…you mean they’re all dead?
There is another way—
The Mother Box.
Wow, look who's knocking on the door to the Batcave. It's that evil and fake Green Lantern.
Green Lantern? No, no. I'm Power Ring. Are you guys looking down on me?
Batman. You CANNOT let him have the box.
It will be the END of your way of life!
Who are you? How did you hack our communicators?
<static>
Hand over the Mother Box! Otherwise, I'll show you the consequences of disrespecting me!
He actually ran away? What a coward. How did such a guy even get into that criminal organization?
We have to get out of here quickly. Our location has been exposed.
We need to get out of here with the Mother Box before their reinforcements arrive.
So, how do we use this... Mother Box?
S.T.A.R. Labs developed a new decryption algorithm that synchronizes directly with the Mother Box.
We can use it to create temporary dimensions to access Boom Tubes.
I guess not even Batman can make boring geek speak sound sexier.
Batman. My name is Harbinger. With me is the one called Pariah.
I know you don’t know us, and trust will be hard.
It’s the box. PANDORA’s Box.
It’s going to destroy your WORLD.
<static>
Why don't you just show it to me... Huh?
I get the feeling we're going to find out. But for now, let's focus on the mission at hand...
Guys. Look at this. I haven't seen this in years.
Wayne Technologies developed an earlier model designed to enhance the human body.
This looks like a S.T.A.R. Labs upgrade.
Collect more equipment like this to help increase our power and fight the Crime Syndicate.
Are you supposed to wear it?
Let me show you.
Wow, it looks like a good fit. Give its power a try.
We have new members, so let's return to base to enhance ourselves before commencing the next part of the plan.
The cruise system shows that our drones just brought back some special resources.
Let's see if there's anything useful.
The surveillance system shows that someone is approaching our location.
Look who I ran into... Catwoman, are you working under Batman again?
I don't have enough lives left to pick any other side, sardine boy.
You're right. But don't think this makes us friends now.
You'd better behave yourself, little fishy, unless you want to become cat food.
Wow! An Encrypted Token! Time for my favorite reality show!
... Selina, we're recruiting allies, not performing on TV.
Whatever. They're the same to me.
First King Shark, and now the notorious leader of the Rogues is joining us?!
The enemy of our enemy is our friend.
I've never liked you so-called "heroes". In my opinion, the Justice League is nothing more but a group of defeated dogs.
Hero, really? Don't go putting any labels on me.
Defeating the Crime Syndicate's the one thing we both agree on.
Yeah, we're gonna team up to take 'em down, but that's as far as our little lovefest's ever gonna go.
Batman, we have received a distress signal!
Now there are people who can send communication signals? Something smells fishy about this.
Analyze the source of the signal and confirm the coordinates.
...The signal came from the Rogues. I need to find out what happened.
The analysis is complete. The location is... in Colorado?
Looks to be the secret facility of the Advanced Research Group for Uniting Superhumans.
The Advanced Research Group for Uniting Superhumans must've installed hidden special equipment capable of sending distress signals.
You don't have to follow me. If it's really my team, I have to go and check it out.
Captain Cold, we have no interest in following you. Your problems are not our problems.
Our objectives are the same. You need to save your companions, and we need reliable allies and resources.
The detestable Batman actually sounds human for once. Nonetheless, it's best that we act separately.
I agree.
Whew. The Green Arrow simulation wasn't nearly as easy as it looked.
Speaking of, we should get Green Arrow on our team. We could really use him now.
Actually, this is good timing. We could really use you on our team.
The Reserve League Center's reconstruction is now complete.
The what now? What are you after, Batman?
We need everyone who can fight to be as strong as they can, if we are going to defeat the Syndicate.
You want to make us stronger? I'm listening...
The Reserve League Center can raise your power up to the level of the five strongest allies we have.
Take a look for yourself.
Batgirl, did you inspect the new toy the drone brought back? They said there's some kind of mystery coordinates on it.
That's a fragment of Pandora's Box. Batman and I are using the S.T.A.R. Labs facilities to analyze the channels of the Multiverse.
Hmm... I can't detect this channel's signal.
No signal means no intel... Why do I get the feeling you're planning on doing something dangerous?
Taking into account the instability of the Multiverse, I wouldn't classify it as safe.
Besides, our daily routine IS dealing with danger, remember?
Fine, say no more. I get it. The great detective is going to put herself in harm's way and investigate the problem herself.
Mm-hmm... And nip the crisis in the bud.
This place is so desolated.
The signal orbs are vibrating like crazy... I think we're at the right place.
Check this out. Te... Los... That's what the signal I decoded says.
I guess this is "Telos", then.
Look at the map, Selina. There's a place corresponding to the coordinates in the signal's wave range!
Look! We can see a signal wave move from Central City to Keystone City. We should investigate…
Interesting… after we visiting all five Cities, it looks like the pattern is changing.\nWe should come back over time to see which cities we can help each day.
I've detected that Mongul's Warworld is approaching... Do you wish to take action?
If you ask me, we should just leave it alone for now. I mean, don't we already have enough on our plate?
Mongul was exiled by Superman long ago. Now that Warworld's code has been rewritten, it's become an arena in the Multiverse.
An arena? Purrfect. I love a good challenge.
Ummm. Didn't someone just say we should leave it alone?
Not much is known about Elseworld... It's extremely dangerous, but it has limitless resource potential.
It's worth looking into.
This is the entrance. We have three random exploration teams, but we can only choose one to go into the real Elseworld.
You may run into familiar faces, but they're all projections controlled by the Seven Deadly Sins.
Do not let down your guard.
Yeah. This area is pure chaos and disorder. Stay alert.
I heard that the Bat family likes to collect information on others.
Yes, the Bat family doesn't go into battles unprepared.
Looks like the rumors are true. I'm interested in that guy with the green hood. Can you get me acquainted with him?
Of course. Come with me.
Huh? This shiny thing is—
—Ah!
It's my data drive! I actually found it!
Hah! And here I thought I'd finally found some jewelry in this place... There's no point in me hanging onto it. Here you go.
I'll connect it to the computer and check it first.
It's as I feared... I pulled it out too quickly—the Oracle system didn't have time to complete the backup.
Still, I managed to download a lot of data. Let me see what we have here—
What is the next step of our battle plan, Batman?
No plan is sufficient while we still lack the strength to fight against the Crime Syndicate head-on.
We still need to recruit more allies.
I think I know a way. Leave it to me.
Fine, fine. Keep hiding your precious battle plans.
Good news. I upgraded the virus you developed and successfully injected it into Grid's surveillance network.
Wow. You're cold-blooded, Batman. To think you'd develop a weapon like that... So what does this mean, Batgirl?
It means we can now launch our attack and hack into Grid's digital network!
Well done, Batgirl.
Let's move out now.
What training are we doing today, Batman?
We'll be training some basic tactics to improve our battle coordination.
Why are you bats training behind my back? Are you afraid that I'll steal your techniques?
Do you even need to train basic tactics with us? You've fought together with Batman for a very long time. You must know him like the back of your palm.
I don't think so. With careful explanation, we may be able to coordinate even better in future battles.
Selina is right. Come with me.
This Batcycle looks pretty cool. Anyone want to take it for a spin?
Why do I feel like the Batcycle... looks different from how I remember it?
This is an experimental S.T.A.R. Labs model. I don't know where they got the Batcycle parts from—it's made from Metal X.
Just how much more stuff did the S.T.A.R. Labs create that we know nothing about?
I found a S.T.A.R. Labs report. If we find parts for certain items, maybe we can try building them with Metal X.
Sounds great.
What are you serious little bats researching now?
The drone brought back some satellite communication equipment... We're trying to connect to Wayne Enterprise's private satellite.
Got it.
Wow! I guess we can track the Crime Syndicate's movements now.
So, when are we going to attack?
Right now. We'll take them by surprise.
But remember—retreat on my command, and don't get carried away.
Don't sweat it. Guerrilla tactics are my forte.
Oh no, the cruise simulation system crashed!
The system fault has caused the surveillance network to stop working!
What happened?
Not sure. It could be a virus. Let's try a system recovery.
The simulation looks different from before. It looks... more dangerous.
The code has been rewritten. Most likely Grid's doing. Be careful.
I caught a small bat. What brings you here?
Good news, Catwoman.
A way has been cleared in the lower levels of the lab. We can finally put those abandoned labs to use!
Labs again? I'd rather have a comfy bedroom to sleep in.
There are many rooms on the lower levels. You might be able to find a suitable room to repurpose as your desired lounge.
That's wonderful! Why don't you show me now?
Woah! There are so many rooms!
I can't wait to design my own room!
I've even prepared a blueprint!
Then let's get started right now!
Fantastic! This has exceeded my expectations in every way!
Wait, the system has detected a distress signal—
Let me see who's in trouble this time.
It seems that your "bat" surveillance has detected a new crisis.
Even if the world came to an end, you would continue to monitor the city's criminal activities, wouldn't you?
Neither I, nor the Justice League, will allow crime to fester in this city.
Fine. That is what makes you so charming, bat.
Who's our target this time?
I'll show you the surveillance that displays our target now.
Something seems to be happening in Warworld again recently...
You mean the Unrestricted Arena opening in Warworld?
How did you find out... Did you also receive an invitation?
Of course. They've sent an invitation to everyone who's participated in an arena match in Warworld before.
They claim that the final champion of the Unrestricted Arena will gain unprecedented honor and wealth.
Sounds appealing. With such a plentiful rewards, does nobody suspect a trap?
That's Warworld. Nothing's impossible. If you really have your doubts, go and take a look for yourself.
This is quite a crowd. So, where do we register?
Wait. If you want to participate in the Unrestricted Arena, you need to have at least 15 characters to form teams for battle.
It seems you'll have to test your popularity before finding out Warworld's intentions, Batgirl.
The current Reserve League Center no longer suits us. Fortunately, I have made some preparations in advance. Come with me.
What's this? A new training system again?
Not exactly. This was originally used by the Justice League to train teams for collaborative battles. After the Crime Syndicate's invasion, Batman redesigned it.
You little bats really can't get enough of this, can you?
If we don't push our limits, who knows what will happen when we face our enemies.
A very "bat" reply. I can't wait to try it.
Remember what I said? This is a collaborative battle system. Just the two of us isn't enough.
Alright, fine. Invite your hero companions for the battle. I don't want to mingle with them.
I have to say, this artifact looks way cooler than those... human enhancement equipment of yours.
Artifacts are very powerful. However, just like the existence of superhumans... when they can no longer protect mankind, we will still need to rely on our own technologies to save ourselves.
But we need them now, and one is clearly not enough. Is there any way we can get other artifacts?
I've already coded all known artifacts into the scanning system so that artifacts can be found by the coordinate locator.
Isn't it time for your night recon? Bad guys aren't going to arrest themselves.
Robin and Nightwing are on patrol tonight. You and I are doing advanced training.
Train. Train. Train. That's all you heroes do. You need to have some fun.
We will... once the Crime Syndicate's been defeated and the world's no longer in chaos.
That'll never happen, Bruce...
Not as long as you keep teaching the bad guys how to be even badder. Right... Selina?
Maybe Batman likes his girls bad, meow?
Catwoman has all the makings of a hero. I intend to bring that out.
We'd all be dead before it happens.
I like the way I am. I don't see any reason to change.
Well, if you don't we'll be having these training sessions with you behind bars.
Thanks for coming, Barbara. This mission needs your expertise.
Happy to help, Bruce. So who do you want Batgirl to smash?
Not Batgirl. I need Barbara Gordon. The best researcher in Gotham City.
Oh goodie. I love it when I can play on the internet. Who's our target?
Dark web chatter says the Joker's planning something very big and very bad... for tonight.
Uhhh... Doesn't he plan something very big and very, very bad every night?
Which is why it's up to us to stop him.
"Us?" Since when did you become a crime fighter? 'Cause when I'm not fighting him...
... You're purr-suing me. But I think that's more for pleasure than for business.
Ahem! Let's keep this professional, Selina.
Of course. Bat-business first. Cat nip later.
So what's up now?
The Crime Syndicate's announced a hundred million dollar reward for our deaths.
Are you joking? A hundred million? Whew. They're not kidding around, are they?
No, they're not. For that kind of money even I thought about killing us.
Glad that you called for back-up instead. So what's the plan?
Considering the threats we're about to face, we need to start training to strengthen our abilities ASAP.
Whew. No wonder you took shelter in the S.T.A.R. Labs tunnels.
It was going to be tough for just Bruce and me, but with you joining Team Bat, I'd say we definitely evened up the odds.
Then what are we waiting for? Let's do this.
It looks like you got my signal, Lenny.
Indeed, I did, Scudder. What are you doing here?
I got separated from the others and have been trying to contact you ever since.
On the upside, I came across a whole load of supplies here.
Nicely done. Are they in that <color=#FAA520>box beside you</color>?
That's right. If you plan on exploring any further, remember to <color=#FAA520>take some supplies with you</color>.
This place is restricted to high-level A.R.G.U.S. personnel only. You can't go in here!
Ahhh...
Unfortunately, I don't have my <color=#FAA520>mountaineering pick</color> with me... Otherwise, I'd be able to climb up here.
They know I <color=#FAA520>hate the cold</color>, but they still sent me here...
No one shall take what is mine. You'd be wise to leave this place!
It's so cold... Fortunately, I built a <color=#FAA520>fire</color> in advance.
Ahhh...
Who am I? Where am I? What am I doing here?
Barbara, you're late.
I ran into a little trouble on the way, but I've already settled it.
Remember what I taught you? Use the Batarang to <color=#FAA520>destroy the light source</color> and take out the enemies.
Let's move. Poison Ivy won't wait at the port just for us.
Hoo... (breathing heavily). That, that wasn't difficult at all.
Looks like you don't need any more rest. Let's continue onward.
Hey, we meet again!
Did you hear about Weather Wizard?
I received intel that he might be with Poison Ivy.
We need to cross the river. I'll freeze it first.
We appear to be after the same thing yet again.
Woah, the lights are so bright here, so unlike Gotham.
It seems that they've even closed the roads. How are we going to sneak in?
Use the Batarang to destroy the light source and take out the enemies in dark.
Heh... Why am I not at all surprised to see you?
What are you doing here, Captain Cold?
Looking for Weather Wizard. He sent me a distress signal.
It should be around here, but I don't know the exact coordinates.
We can help you find your ally. But you must follow my orders.
I don't have much of a choice, do I?
Our target is on the other side of the river—they thought they could stop us by destroying the bridge?
So naive. I can easily freeze the river.
Great. After we get rid of this batch of toxic agent, we're done for the day.
You don't look happy, Captain Cold.
Weather Wizard is not here. I must find him.
Don't fret. At least we know he's in Gotham.
Perhaps you will find him soon.
Lenny! Thank god you received my signal.
I was so worried about you after we separated... Wait. How did you come here?
An ally... It's a long story. Where are the rest?
I don't know. This place seems to be the territory of Advanced Research Group for Uniting Superhumans. I am not able to act freely.
At this point, there is no longer any meaning to any organization.
Follow me, let's search the other places.
There are some <color=#FAA520>supply boxes</color> over there. Let's go see if there's anything good over there.
They don't seem to be people from the Advanced Research Group for Uniting Superhumans.
Who goes there?!
They don't seem to be people from the Advanced Research Group for Uniting Superhumans.
Ahhh...
It seems like others have indeed taken over this place.
Killer Croc! What are you doing here?
Rogues? You've also received the news?
What do you think, Killer Croc?
Those venom samples are ours! Don't you dare steal them from us!
Venom?!
Urgh! How can he be so strong...
Venom... Could he have taken Bane's venom?!
We need to escape this place immediately!
Look Lenny. It's such a cold day yet this lake hasn't frozen over!
Let me test it to see if it really will not freeze.
Batman and Captain Cold? What an unexpected combination!
Bane, hand over your venom.
You don't call the shots!
How heroic, Captain Cold.
Don't make me sick.
You better hurry up and think of a way to get rid of the venom, Batman.
Don't just stand there! Get those things out of here!
My babies are waiting for their nourishment.
What is Poison Ivy transporting? Nourishment... Is that fertilizer?
Fertilizer with a biohazard marking... That's a little unnerving.
We cannot sit back and do nothing!
It's almost time to transport this batch of goods. Sit tight. We're leaving now.
(Roar of armored car traveling)
Killer Croc, it must be tiring to be on watch duty this late at night. Here's the list of goods for this time.
Yes. Men, lower the bridge and let them pass!
We're finally here. I need a rest. You go unload first.
The street lamps are out? Thank god boss had the foresight to prepare night vision goggles.
With the night vision goggles, I'll be able to see as well in the dark. I can continue to be on the alert.
But I hear that you'll become blind if your eyes are exposed to light while wearing these. I must be careful.
Men, stay alert!
Don't let even a fly make its way in!
This must be the communication station mentioned in the intel.
The distress signal should have been sent out from here...
Hey, what's that ahead? Scudder?!
Keep your guard up, guys! We'll have a blast tonight!
Gotham belongs to us!
Uh-oh!
Gotham City Police Department is in trouble! Looks like those people plan to attack the police department.
Act fast and help Gotham City Police Department overcome the danger!
I, uhh, meant to do that.
Sure. And the fortune you wasted on archery lessons taught you to shoot people in the butt.
Tommy, get yourself another beer and quit the lectures. Okay?
If you had listened to any of them maybe your father wouldn't \nhave banished his wayward son to this offshore drilling platform.
Enough with the speeches, man. I say it's party time.
And I say we can do both.
Where the hell did they come from? Queen Security guards this rig 24-7.
Ollie, it hadda be the choppers. The pirates must've used them to breach security.
Attention. The Queen oil platform has been armed with explosives.
We're just here for the oil. Stay out of the way, and nobody gets hurt.
Oh, man, that's  great. Doing nothing's my specialty.
Tommy, are you crazy? There's no way they're gonna leave witnesses. We have to stop them.
Ollie, this is so stupid. We can't stop them.
You'd be surprised at what I can do.
Who are you, man? Cause you're definitely not the Oliver Queen I used to know.
Yeah. I've grown up, but you haven't. So do me favor and stay outta my way.
Dead again. But this time I think it worked just long enough for my signal to get out.
To get it heard. By someone. Anyone.
Least I hope so.
Keep calm, Oliver. You're the boss of Queen Industries.
They're the ones who have to bow and scrape and say, "Yes sir, whatever you want, sir."
You're Oliver freaking Queen. King of the world.  So act like it.
Boss, security's been neutralized. The building's ours.
Hey! What the hell are you people doing?
Neutralized? Then where the hell did he come from?
I- I don't know, boss. I checked out each floor myself.
Looks like you're as thorough as you are stupid.
So now you and me are gonna talk and you're gonna tell me who you are, why you're here...
And what the hell you are doing. Or else.
We were paid to break into the CEO's office and steal papers. Supposed to be top secret stuff.
Nobody's been in that office for weeks, so we thought this was gonna be simple.
Only it wasn't empty. There were people inside.
Hey. I only know what I was told.
Okay. You're useless. Get lost, and don't come back.
Hey, Emerson. Guess who's back?
Ollie? Oh my God. Everyone thought you \ndied in that explosion. Where the hell have you been?
Look. We can talk later. Right now I want to know where my mother is. And why was I told that nobody's been in her office for weeks?
Gotham got hit by a massive blackout.
As soon as your mom heard about the looting and violence, well, you know Moira. She went there straight  to help.
And you let her? My God. Where is she now?
Make a new bow. Carve new arrows. Day in. Day out. Nothing ever changes.
Don't know how much longer I can take this. Talking to myself. Going totally insane.
All I wanna do is scream until I no longer can.
Bow's looking good. Arrows are looking good. Sky's blue. Water's even bluer. Great news. I'm gonna die in paradise. Woo-hooo.
Hell, if half my cash wasn't tied up in Gotham Real Estate,\nI'd be back in Star City the minute after I find my mother.
Moira's working at a food shelter in the Narrows. She'll be fine.
The gangs don't attack food banks.\nBut billionaire Oliver Queen would have a huge target on his back.
Besides, what you really need is some rest and recuperation.
Remind me of that... after my mother's safe.
(Ruffian A) Oh, man, look what the cat dragged in. You dressed for Halloween or what?
(Ruffian B) The dude's trick or treatin' Robin Hood. Ha. What a loser.
(Ruffian C) Game's over, bow-boy.\nHand over your money, or we'll show you what a real weapon can do.
Sorry to disappoint, pal. But no. I don't carry cash.
And two, I'm not interested in playing games with you.
Emerson, you were right. Gotham City really is a hellhole.
Have you been able to track my mother's location?
Yeah. My GPS just locked on her signal. Forwarding it now.
Ollie, you better hurry. A super-villain named Clayface just attacked the station.\nMy contact with them suddenly cut off.
Clayface? Damn.
Batman. Where are you hiding the Queen woman?\nShe and her millions are mine.
Do yourself a favor and forget about her. Moira Queen is under my protection.
Little good that will do her once I kill you.
Get away from her.
You first... I've got this under control.
You control nothing, Batman. I will destroy you both.
Be my guest. Just tell me where you've put my mo-... Ummm... Moira Queen?
And why would I tell that to someone I don't know\nand is dressed up like a poor man's Robin Hood?
Says the man dressed up like a bat. We're on the same side, dude.
Retrace your steps, Arrow. She's waiting for you.
Emerson? You hear that? Try contacting my mother's team again.\nAnd forward the updated coordinates to me ASAP.
So what are Oliver Queen's plans now?
Don't worry about me. I got it covered.
Come on. Don't make promises you know you can't keep.
I'll keep it. I promise.
Mother, Kaisa and others are becoming master archers. Perhaps I should--
Diana, you've been hurt.
A minor wound, mother. Nothing can harm a true warrior.
Daughter!
Don't stop me.
Stop. Do not take another step.
Who are you? Where did you come from?
Are you... from Man's world? You do not look well.
M-my plane... It was attacked. Oh, God... Mars and Mark are gone forever...
I do not know them, but I can help you.
Please.
She says the storm will soon abate.
Tell her thank you.
Your island, Diana... It's beautiful. Paradise.
Indeed. That is why we made this our home. We have no need to walk Man's world.
You've never left this island? Aren't you at all curious about the rest of the world?
We have everything we need right here. There is no reason to go elsewhere.
But what if there's a plague? Or war? Surely there's sickness... and death?
Our care givers can cure any ailments. And we have always been taught that there are no more wars.
If only. Soldiers have never stopped fighting. And yes, people die every day.
Then if this is where Ares, the God of War, is hiding now, I must go stop him. He is evil incarnate.
Alone? You're not a soldier. Step back and let the professionals handle this.
You have no idea what I've been trained to do.
Oh, man. What are you people?
I am Diana, daughter of  Hippolyta, Queen of the Amazons, and Zeus, the King of Olympus.
It is our sworn duty to stop the evil of Ares wherever he goes.
Mother...
Diana, I will not command you, but should you choose this perilous path...
... The island of Themyscira will no longer be your home.
You have not yet recovered from your wounds.
No one will blame you should you choose not to go.
(Silence, then...) To surrender to failure before I even try? No, Mother. That can never be permitted.
I would not deserve to call myself your daughter.
You are my daughter and shall always be so. I will always be proud of you.
Diana, please do not go. We can send a different warrior to Man's world.
You do not need to do so, Aunt. I am an Amazon. I am a warrior.
And I have more than enough power to take down cruel Ares.
Then show me, Diana. Prove yourself.
Earth male, you do not belong on Themyscira. Only the desciples of Hera may tread its hallowed ground.
You need to return to Man's world... Now.
What delays you, man? You must go.
(Diana, where are you?)
Guard this place and don't let anyone pass.
We cannot let anyone else escape with the venom samples!
The source of the signal should be around here...
Hey, what's that ahead... Scudder?!
Stay alert!
We cannot let anyone else steal the venom!
Captain Cold, is what you said really true?
Affirmative! I witnessed Killer Croc stealing Bane's venom.
We cannot let others obtain the venom.
What a coincidence! I was thinking the exact same thing.
Dr. Stone is unable to take your call. Please leave a message after the beep.  BEEP!
C'mon, Dad. You work 24/7 so I know you're there. Answer the damn phone.

Hey, diddle diddle, where is the riddle? It is hidden among the enemies from the <color=#FAA520>Batman Family</color>.
Hey, diddle diddle, where is the riddle? It is hidden among the enemies from <color=#FAA520>Metropolis</color>.
Hey, diddle diddle, where is the riddle? It is hidden among the enemies from the <color=#FAA520>Legion of Doom</color>.
Congratulations. You have found all the answers, but there is one last riddle.
Who knows everything, but nothing about you? Who is present everywhere, but has nowhere uninvaded?
The answer is—Grid!
Don't worry, intruders. You have answered my riddles correctly. I won't reveal your information. See you next time!
Ugh... This defense system has copied the Riddler's personality to a tee...
It may also be Grid's idea of a sick joke.
Strong Lantern Ring energy detected—found it!
Carol? What are you doing here?! It's too dangerous. You shouldn't be here.
Don't give me orders, Hal. My ring grants the same powers as yours. I can come and go freely in any corner of the universe, and of course—beat you up.
I'm just worried about you, Carol. I don't want you to be dragged into such things. You—Jessica? You're here?
Hi... I mean, sorry. I just didn't want to go back alone. Didn't mean to disturb you guys. How do we leave?
I can't leave now. I have to find John. We were sent here together.
I roughly know where he is. I detected energy from another ring on my way here. Follow me.
Why does this place feel like a puzzle game? It seems we should be able to do something with that device on the right.
That's a <color=#FAA520>Digital Wheel</color>. It can change the direction of the pathway ahead, so that we can get to places we couldn't reach earlier.
Sounds good. Let me give it a try.
Hal, there's a strange <color=#FAA520>blue</color> lever here!
Don't touch it. It may trigger some sort of a trap.
—or it may show us the way out.
Another one, but it's <color=#FAA520>yellow</color> this time.
If my guess is correct, using the <color=#FAA520>yellow</color> Digital Lever can change the status of all <color=#FAA520>yellow</color> Digital Roadblocks. Who shall do it this time?
Leave it to me!
Oh no, seems like we've got nowhere to go!
Calm down, Jessica. There's a <color=#FAA520>blue wheel</color> ahead. Perhaps we can use it to turn back.
Good idea, Carol. I'll go first.
Great. A <color=#FAA520>purple</color> Digital Lever. Once we've dealt with that <color=#FAA520>purple</color> Digital Roadblock, we can clear the way out.
Even if we do clear the way out, we can't leave yet. We still don't know where John is.
There's another pathway below. Let's find a <color=#FAA520>green wheel</color> first.
Aha. That was easy!
Let's go. It can change the <color=#FAA520>pathway in the middle</color>. Let's use it to take a look below.
Found it. It's here—oh no! Those monsters are attacking John!
Hey, buddy! I'm here to help!
Too slow, Hal! Jessica? Carol? Great, now's time for my favorite corps battle.
It's good to see you're all right, John.
I feel the same way, especially when I see you bring the "Legion".
I'm not the same color as you.
Legion operations! This feels great! Er... I mean, I rarely get such a chance.
This is your chance, son. Obviously, the advantage lies in us. Let's break a path from here.
There are<color=# FAA520>obstacles</color>blocking our way ahead, and we have to break them to move on.
Look,<color=# FAA520>Digital transmitter</color>! We have met before, and can use it to<color=# FAA520>obstacles</color>.
It seems that you are already a skilled veteran, Jessica.
I guess you've seen this lever before?

<color=# FAA520>Digital Lever</color>. Toggle it to change the switch status of the corresponding color<color=# FAA520>digital roadblock</color>. It's one reason why you can wear rings with other colors when you drive different emotional energy.
Obviously, we should move it to open the way ahead. Maybe I will meet other Lightman.
Look what I said. Kyle, let's help you!
John? Hal? You came in time. These guys are getting more and more difficult to deal with.
How did you say that? The Legion is your eternal backup.
Cut the crap and attack!
Another organ? There are too many mechanisms here. I still don't understand what they are.
According to previous operational experience, this is the<color=# FAA520>Digital Controller</color>. We can use it to move digital transmitters in orbit.
Let me demonstrate.
Hal, report the reconnaissance results.
There are not many enemies in front, but the mechanism is very complex, which is not very pleasant.
Let's make this road happy.
I like this suggestion.
Another one. Does anyone know how to do it?
I met Carol! Use the<color=# FAA520>digital controller over there.
Tell me more in detail.
<color=# FAA520>The digital controller</color>can transmit the<color=# FAA520>digital lever</color>, and move it to the place where we can get it to operate.
Sounds simple. Let me try.
Oh, no! The road to the exit is blocked.
It seems that this ghost place is not going to let us leave lightly. Look, there is a wormhole over there. Maybe you will find a new mechanism through the wormhole.
Smart, I think you have figured out the rules here.
Guys, we did it!
I can finally leave this ghost place. I hope I won't come back again.
Maybe next time it will be covered.
That may not be true.
Guys, let's make a scene!
I don't want to listen to you.
Dick, are you sure we have Bruce's permission?
Well, the obstacles come faster than expected.
Hey, there's a wormhole over there. It looks bad.
I have to go a step ahead, good brothers, please continue to hesitate.
Wow, this thing looks like a fort.
Yes, according to the data recorded by the bat system, it can destroy the obstacles just now.
this matter should not be delayed!
What's this? I can't find any records in the database of Bat System.
Tim, you are too dependent on that system. Let's use our brains.
In general, this thing that looks like the<color=# FAA520>antenna</color>must be related to the<color=# FAA520>beacon</color>at the other end of the<color=# FAA520>wormhole</color>.
Hey, he looks like he can rotate. I think you're right.
As long as the<color=# FAA520>antenna</color>is rotated, the<color=# FAA520>wormhole</color>near the<color=# FAA520>beacon</color>will change its position.
Well done, guys, I said we should use our brains!
I still remember it, another<color=# FAA520>digital transmitter</color>.
But where is it used to shoot?
It can open up the way for us. We will have to be clever.
What's this one? I can't find a record of it in the Bat System database.
Tim, you're relying too much on that system, let's think outside of the box.
Normally, this thing that looks like an <color=#FAA520>antenna</color> is bound to have something to do with the <color=#FAA520>beacon</color> at the other end of the <color=#FAA520>wormhole</color>.
Hey, it looks rotatable, I think you're right.
Just turn the <color=#FAA520>antenna</color> and the <color=#FAA520>beacon</color> near the <color=#FAA520>wormhole</color> will change position.
Good job guys; I told you to be open minded!
I get that my business card says, “Traveling Magician,” Batman, but inside a computer? That’s pushing it.
Grid’s gone to great lengths to partition off this sector of his Digital Universe.
I need to know what he’s hiding. But I can’t break through his firewalls and defenses alone.
So you summoned us? You do realize Zee and I deal in prestidigitation and pentagrams, not ones and zeroes, don’t you?
That’s exactly why I summoned you. Grid has outmaneuvered all my attempts to hack my way in.
But magic is an unknown variable to a synthetic being like him.
In other words, he’s powerless to resist my charms.
Him and me both.
Unexpected. Interesting.
Cryptic. Frustrating. See? I can do it, too.
As predicted, your magic has scrambled Grid’s firewall.
But in doing so, it’s caused widespread data corruption and destabilization throughout the sector.
I’m no techie, but that doesn’t sound great.
Yes and no. Grid’s blockade is down, so we’re free to explore the sector. But we'll lose character data after each battle.
Destabilization’ was puttin’ it mildly. This place is fallin’ to pieces faster than Zee when one of those sad animal adverts come on.
Hey! I’ve met literal demons who couldn’t get through those commercials without shedding a tear.
The interaction between technology and magic has proven to be explosive and unpredictable.
It’s an effective way of circumventing Grid’s defenses, to be sure, but not one without risk.
So, our only option is to undertake an insanely dangerous and experimental course of action? Must be a Tuesday.
I know this is a serious, life-or-death situation we’re in, but something about navigating a virtual world and beating digital bad guys with magic feels...
... Like we’re playable characters in some sort of video game?
Let’s just hope it’s Grid that gets the “game over” and not us.
How you holdin’ up, luv?
Not gonna lie, this is a tough gig. But it’s still nothing compared to working the birthday party circuit.
Five-year-olds these days aren’t impressed unless you manipulate the very fabric of reality itself.
The sector is deteriorating quickly. We're running out of time.
Stand back. Ezilibats!
What did you do?
Hopefully bought us enough time for our grand finale. But we should pick up the pace, the spell won't hold for long.
We’re almost there. Let’s move.
Great news! I think. Where exactly is “there,” again?
With any luck, wherever Grid’s squirrelled away his crypto.
I have no bloody clue what crypto is, I just know I want it.
Phew, got out of there just before the curtain dropped. Did you find what you were looking for, Bruce?
I found something. It remains to be seen if it’ll help us contain Grid.
But I can’t imagine he would go through the trouble of encrypting it and hiding it away in the root of his data vault if it wasn’t important.
Well, I’ll leave you to it then.
The only thing I’m interested in cracking open is a nice bottle of whisky.
Bruce, listen. I'm sorry about the other day—
Get out of my new Batcave, Superman.
N-new what? Okay, fine. We're underground. I guess you can call it a Batcave.
You know I'm a patient person, Bruce. I'm not going to give up that quickly, even if we're at your old Batcave.
... Okay, I forgive you, Clark. You may leave now.
Really? Do you truly forgive me for eating all the cookies Alfred brought for you?
Get out of my sight now, Superman!
Cat, this room is so cozy.
I brought you a bouquet of roses. It's ideal for decorating your cat room.
Thanks, Ivy. I'll take great care of it.
So, now what? Do you feel like watching a movie or going out hunting?
We should throw a housewarming party to spruce up your new home.
Ivy, I don't want your plants to fill up my room.
I'm not Harley. I forbid you to turn my cute room into a botanical garden.
What a pity.
Hello there, cutie bird. Welcome to my new base.
This doesn't look like a billionaire's mansion. But I like it—
This space looks like... it can ensure that nothing gets broken even if we throw hands when arguing.
My invitation came across as a death threat. This, in my opinion, could be your stage.
Could you show me your lovely singing voice, birdie?
Yes, if you're able to live, Green Arrow.
Nightwing, where is my daughter, Rose?
She's where she wants to be.
You only commissioned me to train her. You didn't ask me to be her babysitter or boyfriend.
Seeing you train her to be just like a super hero makes me think the latter might have been better.
Heh, I am a "super hero"! No matter how you look at it, I can't possibly train her to be a super killer.
Then you better away from her in future. I'll turn her into someone who fits my expectations.
Dictatorial dads are a thing of the past, Deathstroke.
It's none of your business.
Hey, Barbara! Is everything alright?
Mr. Grayson, it is not gentlemanly to enter a lady's room without knocking.
I got a message from Oracle. I thought you had been in an accident.
Nothing would happen to Oracle in this base. I do need your help, though.
One of my albums is missing. All of my memories with other girls are stored inside. I was going to give it to Dinah on her birthday...
No worries, my lady. Nightwing is happy to help.
By the way, since you have so many albums, is there a special album for us?
Maybe you should ask other girls, like Stephanie or Cassandra.
Wow, Raven. Your room looks amazing. However, it's a little bit different from what I imagined.
You thought that there will be more magical and demonic elements?
That's right...
Actually, I want my room to have more decorations related to my friends.
I've found it—look at this model of Titans Tower!
I really miss the times we spent in Titans Tower... I remember we had a pajama party with Donna.
I miss them too.
J'onn! I came to look for you the moment I heard that you were safe!
Oh, Flash. I'm good. What did you bring along? I seem to smell...
—Chocolate cookies specially made by Alfred Pennyworth!
I got them from Batman. I thought that you'd like them, so I brought them along to share with you.
Thanks Flash. I think that I should go and thank Batman as well.
Ugh... You better not.
Why?
... Cough! Don't ask.
Keen detectives must maintain high vigilance at all times.
It is vital to quickly identify individuals in adverse surveillance conditions.
Take a look at what my surveillance system has captured.
Let's go. It's training time!
Perfect accuracy comes from countless hours of practice.
Before beginning the next mission, stretch yourself, and warm up.
So, which weapon shall I begin with?
Even time will never be able to wear away at my ambition!
Sinestro Corps! Move out! Attack the other sectors!
Strange earthling, what are you thinking about?
If you permit, I can try forming a telepathic link with you.

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to White Lantern - Kyle
column7: Kyle, you look… you look… Well, I'm just gonna be honest with you. You look like crap. What's wrong?

column4: White Lantern - Kyle to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: Ever since I reformed the White Lantern Ring to fight the Crime Syndicate, I've felt more attuned to the Emotional Electromagnetic Spectrum.

column4: White Lantern - Kyle to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: Hal, it's going haywire. Feels almost like the cosmic equivalent of a power surge.

column4: White Lantern - Kyle to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: Rage… Greed… Fear… Will… Hope… Compassion… Love… I'm being overloaded with emotion.

column4: White Lantern - Kyle to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: Even weirder, some of those emotions feel so familiar, even though I'm sure they're not actually mine.

column4: White Lantern - Kyle to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: It's almost like they're echoes of some other me… Have you noticed anything strange?

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to White Lantern - Kyle
column7: My stomach does feel a little uneasy, but that might just be the gas station bean burrito I had for lunch.

column4: White Lantern - Kyle to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: I wish indigestion was all this was. Unfortunately, I don't think we're gonna be that lucky.

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to White Lantern - Kyle
column7: I've been thinking about what you said, Kyle. About you channeling emotions that felt like yours but weren't.

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to White Lantern - Kyle
column7: It reminded me of Batman's warning. The one about imposter versions of us showing up all over the place.

column4: White Lantern - Kyle to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: You think it's my imposters' emotions I'm sensing?

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to White Lantern - Kyle
column7: It's just a theory. But it seems more than a coincidence that all this weirdness started after the Crime Syndicate arrived.

column4: White Lantern - Kyle to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: But wouldn't that mean those imposters really are us… or at least some version of us?

column4: White Lantern - Kyle to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: And why am I the only one attuned to it?

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to White Lantern - Kyle
column7: You're the only true White Lantern this universe has ever seen. There's a lot we still don't know about your power.

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to White Lantern - Kyle
column7: But what I do know is that you have the full support and resources of the Green Lantern Corps behind you.

column4: Star Sapphire - Carol to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: I came as soon as I could. Is Kyle alright?

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to Star Sapphire - Carol
column7: I'm not sure. One minute we're just hanging out, the next he's rampaging like he's possessed.

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to Star Sapphire - Carol
column7: He's acting like… Well, he's acting like he did when the Entities took control of his body during our fight with Relic.

column4: Star Sapphire - Carol to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: But that's not possible. The Entities are gone. They sacrificed themselves to refill the energy reservoir.

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to Star Sapphire - Carol
column7: Our Entities did, yes. But in some other universe… who's to say?

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to Star Sapphire - Carol
column7: And if these imposters really are us and they managed to cross over into our world, then…

column4: Star Sapphire - Carol to Green Lantern - Hal
column7: Then... what?

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to Star Sapphire - Carol
column7: It doesn't matter right now. The longer Kyle's like this, the greater the odds he'll hurt himself or others.

column4: Green Lantern - Hal to Star Sapphire - Carol
column7: Which means, we'll have to subdue him, at least until he can regain control of himself.
I've never seen the Emotional Electromagnetic Spectrum so unstable. We can't leave it like this.
We've gotten lucky so far, but there's no telling what might happen the next time a Lantern taps into its power.
And that's the last thing we need right now, what with the Crime Syndicate running rampant.
But what do we do? Even the Guardians don't know what to make of this.
Actually, I think you were on to something when you called out that this all began when those evil Justice League lookalikes arrived.
Maybe if we do something about them and the rest of the imposters…
The Spectrum will stabilize? Kind of simplistic reasoning, don't you think?
It's the only idea we've got right now, Carol. I say we try it.
Fine, but let's hurry. This universe is only big enough for one Hal Jordan-sized ego.

Batman, what's wrong? You seem to be facing some sort of difficult situation.
—Not a difficult situation, but a riddle.
Riddle? The Riddler?
The Riddler is controlling the Wayne Tower communication signal and has used that to hack into the Gotham communication network.
Oh no, that means that our surveillance network might be threatened as well...
There is also high-tech research equipment within Wayne Tower that can threaten the citizens. We cannot let the Riddler discover them.
Then what are we waiting for? Let's go stop him now!
He's not at Wayne Tower.
We can only find out where the Riddler is by solving his riddles.
We have to act fast.
I've got it. The Riddler is hiding over there!
What happened... It doesn't seem like the Riddler is here.
... We're late.
It looks like he has already left with someone else.
He even left behind a recording.
It doesn't feel good to be toyed with... Let's see what recording he has left behind for us.
You didn't disappoint me! You solved my riddle!
I've waited for you for a long time!
But what a pity—
I accepted an invitation so I shall make a move first.
Here's my next riddle—Who's the person who invited me?
Hint: It can be cracked, it can be made.
It can be told, it can be played...
That's all. Until next time, goodbye!
Batman, that person—
If the Riddler is really working together with him, it's going to be a massive problem.
No, Barbara.
No matter who teams up on their side, their biggest problem will always be us.
Let's find out what they want. We're going to strike first this time.
No problem, Batman.
Batman, the Riddler started broadcasting to the whole of Gotham. Just what does he want?
It's a high-profile act to show off. Let's see what he's going to say.
Some people like me, some people don't. Sometimes I'm good, sometimes I'm not. What am I?
A riddle as an opening?
The answer is—
You.
You!
I don't know who you are. But you're very smart, just like Batman—
Is there a possibility that Batman himself is the one solving the riddles now?
—But can you answer this new riddle?
The new challenge is about to start right now!
That's all?
We don't have to pay heed to him. Let's just do it at our own pace.
The riddle this time is: What am I?
You'll definitely answer "Edward Nygma"... But that's wrong!
The real answer is—
... A question.
A question!
Then here's the question: Can you solve my riddle today and find out where I am?
I'm looking forward to your challenge.
Batman...
We will find him.
I'm called the Dark, I'm called the Knight. I have no wings, but I soar in Gotham at night.
So, what am I?
You must know the answer—Batman!
Obviously, you're not dead, regardless of what the rumors say.
Batman! Come and find me quickly!
He's too arrogant.
If our movements weren't restricted, we would have caught him already.
Don't be affected by the Riddler, Barbara.
We are close to the answer.
If I possess it, I won't share it. If I share it, I will lose it. What is it?
—A secret! It's a secret. Isn't that right, Batman.
What is the secret of Wayne Enterprises? Is this secret related to you, Batman?
Let's go, Batgirl. It's time for us to set off.
The location of the Riddler is no longer a secret. He won't get away.
Found it!
To think that he's hiding here.
Kids shouldn't touch.
The truth is over here.
The answer is obvious.
It's expected.
This sure is a little unexpected.
Meow.
It's an appropriate metaphor.
It's indeed over here.
A detective would not let go of any possibility.
Batman? How did I end up here...? Wait... This doesn't look like the Batcave.
The Batcave has been invaded by the Crime Syndicate. This is a secret research facility of S.T.A.R. Labs. It will be our base of operations from now on.
S.T.A.R. Labs? A sensible choice. I just about managed to back up the Oracle system before the Crime Syndicate destroyed the Clock Tower—
No! My data drive is missing!
Don't panic. We can send out the drones to search for it.
Hmm... I can't locate the coordinates. The drone seems to have failed.
It looks like we'll have to solve this problem first.
So cold. This is no place for a cat. What are we doing here?
The Crime Syndicate is in control of all the world's networks, so the drone cannot accurately locate anymore.
It seems like the device is still running. Try to see if you can regain control.
I did not expect that there would be enemies...
It seems like this place has also been taken over by the subordinates of the Crime Syndicate.
Looks like it has been restored?
Yes, but it seems like we didn't manage to find Batgirl's information. Only some basic supplies were found.
At least... We don't have to worry about coins and resources anymore.
I think that information might have been lost in Gotham.
The anchor point for Gotham has not been restored yet so let's try progressing further. This way, the drones will be able to continue collecting resources.
Perhaps, we might even find some unexpected treasures!
I could be wrong, but I don't remember today's forecast calling for partly cloudy skies with a chance of fireballs.
What gives, Batman? What are these mechanized monsters and where did they come from?
They're Parademons, genetically modified soldiers from Apokolips. Which means Darkseid's invasion of the Earth has begun.
I'm still new to this superhero thing, but that sounds... bad. It's bad, isn't it?
It is if you value your free will. Darkseid intends to harness a power found on Earth to control the hearts and minds of the entire universe.
Okay, yeah, that's bad. Please tell me you have a plan.
I do, but we'll need to gather as many allies as we can to see it through.
If we can't find a way to unite and collaborate, the Earth is as good as doomed.
There's no end to these Parademons! On their own, they're not so tough…
But every time I knock one down, two more seem to appear in its place.
You're not far off.  Parademons are capable of processing and repurposing organic material into new Parademons.
Which means...?
That if you don't want to end up becoming one of them, try focusing on attacks that can take out multiple Parademons at once.
I've got good news and bad news, Batman.
The good news is we managed to track the Parademons back to the power plant.
The bad news is this wizard-looking dude was waiting for us there. Seems like he's gonna be trouble.
Must be Desaad, Apokolips' chief scientist, one of Darkseid's Elite, and a powerful psychic.
He'll likely try to debilitate us with his tech and psionics, so it'll behoove us to have means to counter them ready.
Fortunately, I anticipate his overreliance on both will leave him vulnerable to physical attacks. We should take advantage of that.
How do you always know all this stuff?
Actually, scratch that, I'm pretty sure I don't want to know.
You struggle in vain, Earthling. Lord Darkseid has conquered thousands of planets.
He has enlightened countless civilizations to the great darkness, granting them absolution and unity under his authority.
Do you, a primitive, truly believe you can stop him from claiming the Anti-Life Equation and taking his rightful place as the Supreme Being?
Alone? No.
But you would be surprised what us 'primitives' can do when we unite. When we combine our strengths, we are mighty.
Mighty enough to even best a god? One capable of striking you down in a single blow?
Wouldn't be the first time.
Thank you all for your assistance thus far fending off Darkseid's forces.
Don't mention it. Rrreally, don't. We have rrreputations to maintain, afterrr all.
I realize we've had our differences in the past, but I hope we can continue to count on you in the battle against Steppenwolf.
We had little choice, didn't we?
If we'd left saving the world to the Justice League, we'd all be Parademons by now.
Yeah, and no one gets to enslave the Earth but us!
Now if you'll excuse me, I'm off to steal candy from a baby. All these heroics are grossin' me out.
It's good to go home in the humid air and chaotic night~
Don't let your guard down, Selena. We don't know which force is occupying Gotham Police Station.
Obviously, this is the reason why we don't go through the main gate and have to come in through the water system. Don't worry, Bat, I know very well.
Paradise Island is the hometown of Amazons and the hometown of the Wonder Woman. It is said that thanks to the protection of the gods, this island is difficult to find on the map.
Then why can the auto drive system of the Bat fighter directly navigate here... Well, I see, because it is a "Bat" fighter.
The superhuman criminals in Bellif prison have been released. What about Waller's suicide team? Have they abandoned their base?
It seems that this place has changed from a prison to a paradise for criminals.
RIZ-ZOAWD? No, it has become hell.
The blue sky and desert are beautiful from afar... If we had ventured into the country of Black Adam like this in peacetime, we would have been surrounded now.
Now, we need all the allies we can find.
Oh, that Gotham rich family. I heard Bruce Wayne is your gold owner. Is it true, Batman?
You can think so.
wow Do you have any hidden transactions before? For example, hey, I haven't finished yet. Don't go so fast.
Why do we come to this inconspicuous farm - wait, there is a Superman sign. Is this about Superman?
not eye-catching? Krypton spaceship carrying Superman landed in the wheat field over there.
The Kent's barn is ahead. Let's go.
Quinn Industries is the industrial giant of Star City, specializing in the production of weapons and ammunition. There may be resources we can use here.
The Quinn? It's said that his industry has been in a state of decline. I think he will have to declare bankruptcy after this crisis.
Planetary Daily? What are we doing here? Is it to follow the trail of Superman?
We need to find a person who has a close relationship with Superman. She will help us contact the military forces.
She? Is it Louise Lane?
Wow, I didn't expect to come to the tribe of fish.
Atlantis, an ancient country sunk in the Atlantic Ocean, is now under the rule of the sea king.
We need the help of Atlantis. And... Meila should know what happened to Arthur.
Huh... even I feel cold... It's hard to imagine that there is a secret base in such a ghost place.
However, this snow mountain is really suitable: easy to defend but difficult to attack, and well-equipped. I really want to know how you came in without the landing permission of the tower?
Batman doesn't need any permission. The criminals in Tieshan Prison should not be here more than I am.
Those who have not received the invitation cannot board Paradise Island. As for how I came here
As long as you tell me the coordinates, I can move with the mirror - you must ask, how do I know the coordinates of Paradise Island?
Belliff... Hum
I left Penadoro alone, and the cage failed to kill me - and now I will be the king of Belrif!
It's not that easy, Bain.
Hey, magician, I bet you can't "whew" them all at once!
Magic doesn't work like this... Forget it, why should I reason with the madman? Bat, why are you here?
Haley, Constantine, we need to talk to you.
Cut, you Bats are really boring as always... jugglers, or let's compare who can smash more heads!
Fool, why are you here? Where's Luther?
Bizarro doesn't understand what you're talking about.
That can only be communicated with fists.
Jason, why are you doing this?
Look, old man. Whatever Jason Todd you know or knew...
He's not me.
I guess the front desk didn't receive your visitor registration?
Ah oh.
Maybe I should take the time to strengthen the security system.
It is said that the security system of Quinn Industries is airtight. But
No matter how high a building is, there is no lack of sewers.
Hey, Ivy, long time no see.
Selena? Now you start hanging out with bats?
The time is different.
... Forget it. It's none of my business. But you know, it's better not to disturb my action. Otherwise, I have to try new toxins with you.
But you get in my way, you slow me down, I have six different toxins aimed at you right this minute.
Bizarro, why are you here?
He invited Wo to his house... Wo couldn't find the way
... Gotham is really easy to get lost at night. Go to the safe house with red hood or Wayne Manor? I can give you a lift.

Batman, what Captain Cold said earlier... Did the Crime Syndicate really beat the whole Justice League?
I’m afraid so.
Are they... are they dead?
With all my heart...
...I hope not.
Batman, are you sure about this? If Wonder Woman’s really gone...
...I don’t think the Amazons would take that news well, frankly.
Come on, WE didn’t do it. It’s not like they’ll KILL us or anything, right?
I shoulda stayed in Gotham.
Okay, what’s going on? Why are they GOOD guys fighting with the BAD guys to fight against US?
I don’t know. But I’m guessing it has something to do with whoever unleashed those ENHANCEMENTS.
Have y’all noticed that every time we make a planned rendezvous, someone’s waiting to bash our heads in?
It crossed my mind.
Swell. The bats have a RAT.
I hope Superman’s here. We’re running out of time.
Worst than that, we’re running out of HOPE.
Batgirl. Batman. Arthur’s here. He’s returned.
Well, that’s good news, right?
I wish it was.
Whatever that thing is... I don’t think he’s my husband.
I think maybe we’re chasing the wrong end of the snake, here.
Oooh, I love it when you use animal metaphors!
The Syndicate, the enhancements, they all started when Pandora’s BOX was stolen from Themyscira.
Hooking up with the island’s silver mirror, we can retrace the Box’s route, and... uh oh.
There’re Syndicate forces here already. And you’re not going to like who’s LEADING them!
Excuse me, is a Mr. Batman available for a friendly chat?
You’re not Pariah or Harbinger, and this is a closed com line. Who ARE you.
Oh, you may simply refer to me as an Outsider, Mr. Batman.
I’m going to suggest you stop trying to follow my tracks, detective. Or I shall be forced to do something I very much do NOT wish to do.
If Batman come here, me CRUSH him to show respect!
I’m afraid that honor belongs to ME, Bizarro.
Batman, what are you doing in Kahndaq? Last I heard, you were terrorizing Belle Reve!
Apparently, there’s some sort of imposter wearing my cowl. It’s... irritating.
We’re trying to trace the artifact you and your friends tried to steal, Cold. Pandora’s Box.
Honestly, you steal one calamity-bringing artifact and suddenly you're the bad guy.
If you want Pandora's Box so badly, Batman, then why don’t you come and take it?
What the in the world? If you’re here, who’s breaking into our comms?
Good question. Let’s find OUT.
Robin, I’m... dealing with a little bat problem in Kahndaq. I need surveillance at Wayne Manor.
What exactly am I looking for, Batman?
Some very bad people, I’d say. And some just MIGHT look like friends. No one gets in the cave, is that clear?
Hold the line. It’ll be done.
And Robin...
...bring some BACK-UP.
Wait... you’re saying Kal El’s ALIVE?
Uncertain, Supergirl. But he’s been spotted, we think. By reliable witnesses.
WHAT reliable witnesses?
Well, myself, for one.
The thing is... this is awkward.
The thing is, the Superman WE saw was batting for the wrong TEAM.
That’s impossible.
It’s unlikely, agreed. Can you do a scan of Smallville? We need to make sure he’s found, if he really is out there.
And Kara... be careful.
FLASH! I never thought I’d say this, but I’m actually glad to SEE you! Everyone thought the Syndicate KILLED you.
I remember the battle, then a flash, no pun intended.
Nothing after that.
Well, Batman’s trying to trace the box that those monsters came out of. He thinks if we can find it, we can send them BACK.
This honestly sounds more like a Zatanna thing than a ME thing.
Not a bad idea, now that you mention it...
Wait, you want ME to look for a possibly homicidal SUPERMAN? What am I supposed to do, throw white doves and rabbits at him?
Zatanna, magic affects us Kryptonians just like it affects humans. It’s one of our weaknesses.
All right. I’ll try.
ANNATAZ, YLF OT SILOPORTEM!
I don’t think I’ll ever get used to that.
I’m not used to being ordered around by flying rats, Batman.
You’re the most qualified for this, Captain Cold. I need you to get inside the ARGUS Base. See if they have the Box.
And WHY am I the lucky number who gets this honor?
Because you’re DRESSED for it, Cold.  It’s in the ARCTIC.
This is what I get for being FASHIONABLE.
It’s as I said, Batman. Aquaman is here, but...
But he’s not the Arthur you married. I’m sorry, Mera.
We’re getting reports of a handful of the missing Justice Leaguers—
...the PRESUMED DECEASED Justice Leaguers...
Tactful, Catwoman. Of the MISSING Justice Leaguers popping up in trouble spots all over the world.
How did you spot that he might be a duplicate of some kind?
Well, his pet octopus won’t go NEAR him.
Queen Hippolyta, Wonder Woman’s mother, says they’ve tracked the entity that stole Pandora’s Box from the care of the Amazons.
Nightwing and I stopped the villains from stealing the Box from the Gotham Museum of Antiquities.
I handed it over to Wonder Woman myself, thought it would be safer here.
It was a good instinct, Batgirl. You couldn’t have known.
Batman... what if all of this was my fault?
Cold! What are you doing back in Belle Reve? How did you even GET inside a maximum security metahuman holding facility?
Well, see, my old buddy MIRROR MASTER, he’s like a living skeleton key!
The Syndicate’s already broken free half the prisoners, Batman.
We wanted to see if there’s any still here that’ll come over to OUR side.
I wonder... whose side are YOU on, Captain?
Batman. We’re trying to break through, but there’s some kind of barrier around Earth... trying to STOP us, I think.
There isn’t much TIME. Earth is on the EDGE of EXTINCTION!
Listen, both of you. We’re fighting a war here against an enemy we can’t even SEE.
WHO IS IT who called for the Syndicate to come through Pandora’s box?
More importantly, can we STOP them?
We repelled the invaders, father. It was... odd.
Odd?
One of the invaders was ME.
There’s a lot of that going around.
I’ve scanned the entire county three times, Batman. There’s no sign of Superman that I can detect.
All our data says he was HERE.
Well, if he was, he’s gone now.
All right, Supergirl. I have another task for you.
Shoot.
There’s some sort of energy barrier around the Earth. I need you and Green Lantern to find the source and shut it DOWN.
Copy that.
FLASH. It’s really YOU, right?
No idea what you mean, but yes, it’s me, Batman. What’s up?
We’re looking for an artifact, it could save the world. You up for a search mission?
Sure. How big’s the area?
Well, just five continents, so far.
>Heh< Give me something HARD next time.
Okay, I’m officially taking charge of the search for Pandora’s Box, Batman. You coordinate the resistance to the Syndicate’s power grab, agreed?
I’m being replaced on a mission I started?
No offense, Batman. But this is kind of what I DO.
We’re going to Metropolis. I need a hero from there to help me search.
But we already LOOKED here for Superman!
Not Superman. Lois LANE.
Hello, Batman. Do you remember Bane, the man who BROKE you?
I remember putting you in prison, if that’s what you’re asking.
I am giving you a friendly warning, detective.
The A.R.G.U.S. Base is under MY protection. Do not trespass on what BANE safeguards.
We’ll see, Bane.
I broke you once. I can do it AGAIN.
COLD. We need you back at the A.R.G.U.S. Base, pronto!
Why would I want to go back to THAT godforsaken place?
We have reason to suspect that BANE is processing and stockpiling hordes of VENOM, the chemical mix that makes him superhuman.
Couldn’t you have been the brilliant detective the FIRST time I went?
Excuse me?
>Sigh< Never mind. I’m on it.
Mr. Batman. I thought I told you to quit following my TRAIL.
Outsider. I know you stole the box from Themyscira. And I suspect you opened it to summon the SYNDICATE.
Keep going, this is very entertaining.
If you open it again, you could curse the world to an endless PLAGUE.
Outsider...
I have to go. Last warning. Stop SHADOWING me.
>Transmission ended<
You thinking what I’m thinking?
He doesn’t have it. He lost Pandora’s Box!
If the Outsider doesn’t have Pandora’s Box, then his PRIORITY is going to be LOOKING for it.
He’ll retrace his steps. We have to alert the Amazons.
Let me handle this, Batman. They’ll listen better if it comes from me.
AMAZONS. Your island is in DANGER.
The OUTSIDER may be heading your way. Can you STOP him?
We vow it.
To defend our people and our queen.
With our lives, if necessary.
We VOW it.
G’day, Batman. Fancy chattin’ with you from prison, like this!
Captain Boomerang! How’d you get access to our comm line?
Oh, I’m a resourceful bloke, once you get to know me.
I mean, I fight the world’s fastest man with a bent piece of WOOD, don’t I?
Harkness. The other Rogues are working with us. You help us save the Earth, I’ll speak to the authorities about an early parole.
Well, see, that’s right nice, but I’m afraid I’ve gone and paroled MYSELF.
I’ll still help, though. Earth’s a good Sheila and I’m quite FOND of her.
Batman? You there?
How’s your recon going, Flash? Any sign of the Box?
The trail’s led here, I think. If I can stay clear of the local metahumans, we might have a shot at recovering the Box before it causes any more damage.
I could use some help, Batman. I can run around the Earth in a blink, but it’s INTEL I need here.
Understood. Batgirl?
I know what you’re going to say.
We need the BIRDS OF PREY.
Okay, Birds. We have a mission and time’s running out.
We need every resource we HAVE to look for intel on the location of Pandora’s Box. Maybe we can do what the Flash CAN’T.
I’m in. Sitting around doing nothing was never my style anyway.
I’m ready. Let’s go HUNTING.
Nice. We’re back.
The one and only BIRDS OF PREY.
Batman. This is Harbinger.
Your champions, Green Lantern and Supergirl, are working on finding a hole in the shield around Earth.
But I’m afraid we’re running out of time.
We’re very aware, Harbinger. We’re doing all we can.
This is Pariah, Batman. My visions... I see your world run by MONSTERS. And I see continents cracking in half and volcanoes spewing fire.
You have to HURRY. Or that’s just the BEGINNING!
Well, we may not be the best of mates, but it’s nice to see you lot after being locked up for so long.
Imagine, the ROGUES working as HEROES for a change.
Good to see you, too, Digger. We need all the brainpower we can get.
Yeah, right, right. About THAT...
Oh, no. What have you done?
Well, I only reached out and brought in an old ALLY, haven’t I?
Hello, humans. I am told we have an ENEMY to rend into pieces?
This isn’t good.
Batman... I’ve got some disturbing news from Metropolis.
Can’t WAIT to hear this, Batgirl.
I spoke with Lois Lane. She said Superman came to visit her at the Planet. Told her everything was going to be okay.
Correct me if I’m wrong, but that’s GOOD news, isn’t it?
She said it wasn’t Superman. She’s positive.
It was something LIKE Superman.
We’re in trouble, Batman.
I think I underdressed.
I TOLD you the place was cold.
Gorilla City is a tropical zone. I don’t like this, EITHER.
Let’s get the venom and get OUT, right?
Watch out for Bane. I got a bad feeling he’s still HERE.
Status report, Robin.
Panic. People are frightened, Batman. They don’t know who to trust.
Let me suggest a dangerous option: We enlist the inmates at Arkham.
No. Absolutely not.
You have already recruited criminals from Belle Reve and Enclave M...
And they are motivated by self-interest. They need Earth to survive and they are aware of that.
Can you say the same of the inmates at Arkham?
Have you identified the creature pretending to be my husband, Batman?
Queen Mera. I regret to say we haven’t.
I hate to say this, but perhaps you should close the city dome. Make sure he doesn’t have access. Until we KNOW it’s safe.
I’m afraid we’re doing more than that, Batman.
We’re closing the dome to EVERYONE.
Even your people, Batman.
I’m sorry.
